observations: Photo 0: A disassembled car engine with a black plastic engine cover, attached front subframe, struts/coil springs on both sides, and red fuel rail covers, sitting on a wet gravel/tarmac yard.

Photo 1: A gearbox/transaxle unit coupled to what appears to be the same engine, surrounded by other engines, struts and CV axles in a salvage yard, exhaust manifold/catalytic area visible with surface rust.

Photo 2: Same engine/transaxle assembly from another angle, showing the drive shaft stub of the transmission, struts, and a rubber boot on an axle; a boot-clad foot is visible in frame bottom, confirming an outdoor open-air yard.
A semi-transparent watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' across all three photos - this is the seller's business name/watermark, not a vehicle brand or model marking.
No engine code plate, VIN, or manufacturer badge is legible in any photo.
Parts show dirt, oil residue, and some surface rust consistent with a used/pulled engine stored outdoors; no visual sign of a start-up test or bench test.

identity.kind: used car engine and transmission assembly with attached struts (salvage yard pull)

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim about product range; no photo or document shows inventory breadth or sourcing.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (compression, bearings, etc.)
risks.proof: A start-up video or compression test reading

risks.risk: Unknown make, model and engine code, which drives compatibility and price tier
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code plate/tag or casting number
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; generic 'engine' price range is too wide to quote

risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or paperwork/invoice showing pull history

risks.risk: Corrosion or water ingress from prolonged outdoor storage on wet ground
risks.proof: Close-up of oil pan, intake, and electrical connectors for rust/water staining

risks.risk: Incomplete assembly (missing sensors, wiring harness, ECU, injectors)
risks.proof: Full inventory photo listing every included component

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/casting number or any VIN/identification plate
Photo or short video of the engine starting or being tested
Confirmation of which car make/model/year this engine and transmission are from
Close-up of oil pan, connectors, and intake for rust/corrosion check
Full list/photo of all included components (sensors, harness, ECU, etc.)
response.reason: The photos show a used engine/transmission assembly but no readable engine code, make, or model, which is essential to even set a worst-case price for a car spare part with this much value variance; a tag or code photo is needed before pricing.
